spec.description: High-level health and policy-enforcement view for Gatekeeper: admission webhook data, audit freshness, violation counts, and the loaded policy inventory.

spec.title: Violations over time by enforcement action
spec.description: Refreshed once per audit run (default every 60s). A step change means resources were created or remediated, or a constraint was added, changed, or promoted from dryrun to deny.

spec.title: Current violations by enforcement action
spec.description: Latest audit run only.

spec.title: How to find the offending resources

options.content:
`gatekeeper_violations` is only broken down by **enforcement action** — upstream Gatekeeper does not attach a constraint or resource label to it.

To identify what is actually failing:

- `kubectl get constraints` — the `TOTAL-VIOLATIONS` column breaks the number down per constraint.
- `kubectl get <constraint-kind> <name> -o jsonpath='{.status.violations}'` — lists the offending resources (capped at 20 per constraint by default).
- `kubectl logs -n gatekeeper-system -l control-plane=audit-controller` — full audit output.

spec.title: Validation requests/sec by admission status
spec.description: Every create or update routed to the validating webhook. `deny` here means Gatekeeper actively blocked an apply.

spec.title: Validation webhook latency
spec.description: Webhook response time. The API server gives the webhook 3s before timing out, and with failurePolicy=Fail a timeout becomes a rejected request.

spec.title: Mutation requests/sec by admission status
spec.description: Traffic through the mutating webhook, driven by the Assign/AssignMetadata mutators.

spec.title: Share of admission requests denied
spec.description: Denials as a fraction of all validation requests. A sustained rise after a policy rollout is the signal that a new constraint is triggering harder than intended.

spec.title: Webhook replicas up
spec.description: Healthy gatekeeper-controller-manager scrape targets. The validating webhook runs here and is configured with failurePolicy=Fail.

spec.title: Audit run duration
spec.description: How long a full audit sweep takes. Growing duration means audit is falling behind the cluster. If duration exceeds the audit interval, violation data is permanently stale.

spec.title: Time since last completed audit
spec.description: Should be between 0 and the audit interval.

spec.title: Audit runs per hour
spec.description: Completed audit sweeps per hour.

spec.title: Constraints by enforcement action
spec.description: Loaded constraints split by what they do on a violation. Use it to confirm a policy actually landed in deny and did not stay in dryrun.

spec.title: Constraint templates by status
spec.description: ConstraintTemplates ingested. Anything in `error` means the Rego failed to compile, and every constraint built on that template is inert.

spec.title: Watched vs intended GroupVersionKinds
spec.description: Gatekeeper caches the resource kinds its policies reference. A persistent gap between intended and watched means the watch manager is stuck and referential policies may evaluate against a stale cache.

spec.title: Audit replicas up
spec.description: Healthy gatekeeper-audit scrape targets. Audit is the only pod that reports gatekeeper_violations, so when it is down the violation counts become stale.

spec.title: CPU usage by pod
spec.description: CPU cores used by pods in gatekeeper-system.

spec.title: Memory working set by pod
spec.description: Working-set memory for pods in gatekeeper-system. Compare against the configured limits when investigating restarts.

spec.title: Violations - Deny
spec.description: Resources currently violating a **deny** constraint, as of the last audit run. These already exist in the cluster — the webhook only blocks *new* admissions. Associated with GatekeeperPolicyViolationsDetected alert.

spec.title: Violations - Dry Run
spec.description: Violations of constraints running in dryrun. Nothing is blocked — use this to size the blast radius before promoting a constraint to deny.

spec.title: Violations - Warn
spec.description: Violations of constraints running in warn. The request is admitted but the user gets a warning.

spec.title: Constraints active
spec.description: Constraints successfully loaded.

spec.title: Constraints in error
spec.description: Constraints Gatekeeper could not load — usually a bad ConstraintTemplate or a Rego compile error. A constraint in error enforces nothing, so this should be zero.

spec.title: Since last audit
spec.description: Age of the most recently completed audit run. Violation counts are only as fresh as this.

spec.title: Gatekeeper — Policy Enforcement
